title: Identification of novel antioxidant collagen peptides for preventing and treating H(2) O(2) -induced oxidative stress in HepG2 cells through in vitro and in silico approaches.
authors: Du, Bowei; Zhang, Chao; Deng, Guiya; Zhang, Shuai; Wang, Shiqi; Guan, Yuepeng; Huang, Yaqin
journal: Journal of the science of food and agriculture
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接筛选抗氧化胶原肽与Keap1蛋白的互作，虽涉及蛋白-肽结合建模，但对象为Keap1蛋白而非DNA，且方法仅用分子对接，与TF-DNA互作课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Nowadays, the prevalence of oxidative stress-related chronic diseases is increasing. The identification of novel antioxidant collagen peptides to counteract oxidative stress for individuals' health has gained significant attention. RESULTS: In this study, collagen peptides with antioxidant activities were separated and identified by ion chromatography, reversed-phase high-performance liquid chromatography and liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. The identified antioxidant collagen peptides were further screened by molecular docking for Keap1-targeted peptide inhibitors and their theoretical interaction mechanisms were investigated. Four novel antioxidant collagen peptides, GPAGPIGPVG, GPAGPpGPIG, ISGPpGPpGPA and IDGRPGPIGPA, with high binding affinity to Keap1 were selected. Molecular docking results demonstrated that the putative antioxidant mechanism of the four antioxidant collagen peptides contributed to their blockage of Keap1-Nrf2 interactions. The results of antioxidant activity of the four antioxidant collagen peptides proved that IDGRPGPIGPA exerted a high scavenging capacity for DPPH and ABTS free radicals, while GPAGPpGPIG improved the resistance of cells to hydrogen peroxide-induced oxidative damage by promoting the activation of intracellular antioxidant enzymes and the production of reduced glutathione in human hepatoma (HepG2) cells. CONCLUSION: The antioxidant collagen peptides (GPAGPIGPVG, GPAGPpGPIG, ISGPpGPpGPA and IDGRPGPIGPA) will be developed as novel functional food for human health in the near future. abstract_zh: 背景：目前，与氧化应激相关的慢性疾病患病率日益上升。为促进个体健康，寻找新型抗氧化胶原蛋白肽以对抗氧化应激已引起广泛关注。结果：本研究通过离子色谱、反相高效液相色谱和液相色谱-串联质谱法分离并鉴定了具有抗氧化活性的胶原蛋白肽。进一步通过分子对接筛选所鉴定的抗氧化胶原蛋白肽，以寻找靶向Keap1的肽抑制剂，并探讨其理论相互作用机制。筛选出四种新型抗氧化胶原蛋白肽，即GPAGPIGPVG、GPAGPpGPIG、ISGPpGPpGPA和IDGRPGPIGPA，它们对Keap1具有高结合亲和力。分子对接结果表明，这四种抗氧化胶原蛋白肽的推定抗氧化机制在于其阻断Keap1-Nrf2相互作用。四种抗氧化胶原蛋白肽的抗氧化活性结果证明，IDGRPGPIGPA对DPPH和ABTS自由基具有高清除能力，而GPAGPpGPIG通过促进人肝癌（HepG2）细胞中细胞内抗氧化酶的激活和还原型谷胱甘肽的产生，提高了细胞对过氧化氢诱导氧化损伤的抵抗力。结论：抗氧化胶原蛋白肽（GPAGPIGPVG、GPAGPpGPIG、ISGPpGPpGPA和IDGRPGPIGPA）将在不久的将来开发为有益于人类健康的新型功能性食品。（c）2023年化学工业学会。
